title: What's new in Sustainability (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Value chain emissions and scope three tracking
Purchase order demo with formulas and fixed assets
Sales order and item journal demo with item tracking
Item reclassification and service order demo
Fixed asset emissions and collect from GL improvements

features.name: Formulas in purchase order and purchase invoice
features.description: Sustainability formulas are now available in purchase order and purchase invoice documents, allowing emissions calculation based on distance and other parameters in the same way as in journals.
caveats: Formulas are read-only after posting; only certain fields like distance can be modified

features.name: Improved sustainability entry discovery
features.description: Enhanced navigation to find sustainability entries across the system using the same interface as other entry types, making it easier to locate details.

features.name: Value chain emissions in item journals
features.description: Value chain emissions tracking is now available in item journals, item reclassification journals, fixed asset reclassification journals, and service management.

features.name: Scope three tracking by item tracking level
features.description: Scope three emissions can now be tracked at the item tracking level, allowing users to define average or specific methods on the item card for tracking emissions by lot or serial number.

features.name: ESG report layout with lot details
features.description: The ESG report layout has been improved to print information per lot, enabling more granular emissions reporting by item tracking.
caveats: Report output is called 'ECG' in the transcript but likely refers to ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance)

features.name: Sustainability ledger entry reversal
features.description: Sustainability ledger entries can now be reversed using a standard reverse button similar to general ledger entries, but only for entries created through journals, not documents.
caveats: Reversal only works for journal entries; entries posted through documents cannot be reversed

features.name: Collect from GL with posting memory
features.description: The collect amount from GL function now remembers what has already been posted and suggests only the remaining amount to post, improving the posting workflow.
caveats: Date filters help control the suggestion behavior

features.name: Fixed asset emissions in journals
features.description: Fixed asset journals now include sustainability columns for emissions tracking, including sustainability account and CO2 totals in both general and reclassification journals.
caveats: Fixed asset reclassification allows CO2 percentage splitting similar to acquisition cost

features.name: UDR certificate capture
features.description: UDR certificate capture functionality is available for sustainability tracking, with detailed explanation deferred to a separate video.
caveats: Details not provided in this video

quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the availability of a previously journal-only feature in document types, expanding the scope of emissions calculation capabilities.

quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates a significant expansion of scope three emissions tracking granularity to the item tracking level, enabling lot and serial number-based emissions.
